suite_name: Airtel SMS cases that can be run on the phone
description: Field SMS and MMS cases that a normal Airtel SIM can run with Android SmsManager, the SMS database, android-smsmms, and MobileInsight or SCAT where the sheet asks for a radio log. Lab rows, roaming, band-to-band moves, captive Wi-Fi, and emergency cases are omitted.

test_metadata.title: MT SMS GSM in allowed area
test_metadata.objective: MT SMS GSM in allowed area

prerequisites.smsc: Use the SMSC already stored on the Airtel SIM. Do not set a private SMSC.

execution_procedure.instruction: Manually select 2G NRP or, if available select 2G Only Mode on NW settings menu.

Send an SMS from the UE.

test_metadata.title: IMS IDLE MT SMS from IMS subscriber on home network (3 UK IMS)
open_source_tools: MobileInsight or SCAT for the radio or SIP log
test_metadata.objective: IMS IDLE MT SMS from IMS subscriber on home network (3 UK IMS)

prerequisites.smsc: Use the SMSC already stored on the Airtel SIM. Do not set a private SMSC.

execution_procedure.instruction: 1) DUT is powered on and completes IMS registration on a LTE cell (Cell A with IMS VoPS=1 -> IMS supported)
2) Compose and send  a MO SMS from UE B to the to DUT with up to 160 characters.

checks: Examine UE logs from the DUT to establish:
1)  that the DUT completes IMS registration.
2)  that the DUT receives a MT SMS via IMS from UE B
All steps under test procedure are successfully executed, and the DUT returns to RRC idle state after the test is completed.
expected_result.pass_when: The SMS or MMS database on this phone shows the message, and every check below is true.

prerequisites.smsc: Use the SMSC already stored on the Airtel SIM. Do not set a private SMSC.

execution_procedure.instruction: 1) Send SMS from VoWiFi DUT to other VoWiFi supported device (160 character length)

checks: 1) SMS is sent by DUT
2) Other device receives SMS
3) Message content is correct
4) No misbehaviour seen on DUT during or after SMS
expected_result.pass_when: The SMS or MMS database on this phone shows the message, and every check below is true.

prerequisites.smsc: Use the SMSC already stored on the Airtel SIM. Do not set a private SMSC.

execution_procedure.instruction: 1) DUT initiates a FTP download
2) After FTP is started send an SMS
3) Wait for FTP to complete

checks: 1) FTP starts correctly
2) SMS sent and receive correctly
3) SMS has no impact on FTP
5) Data call completes download
expected_result.pass_when: The SMS or MMS database on this phone shows the message, and every check below is true.
